scope: Exactly frozen 300 literal rsync files; no remote execution by preparation or static preflight.

transport.route: One literal <decimalID>/pg<decimalID>.txt per fresh stage. No recursive/files-from/archive/delete/resume/compression/auth/proxy/config/runtime fallback.
transport.trust: Unencrypted native rsync public mirror; no TLS/publisher checksum or catalog-version-equivalence claim.
transport.bytes: Received rsync application stream includes greeting/file-list/checksum/data, bounded before forwarding: 2.5MB each and 750MB aggregate. Not physical packet/TCP retransmission wire bytes. Plaintext file maximum 2.4MB. Ledger actual body hashes/lengths describe this received application stream; file SHA/size recorded separately.

charge: Exclusive existing IntakeLedger lock held throughout profile and reconciliation. 800MB output before any owned file; 2.5MB and one request before each attempt/listener/source IO. Attempt keys must all be absent; no charge refunds/replay. Failed partial charges retained. Generated metadata is not downloaded body bytes.
continue: Only exact recognized missing, independently bounded oversize skip or independent network timeout may advance next frozen record; success resets consecutive failures, third consecutive independent failure terminates. All protocol/path/policy/custody/resource/budget/ledger errors stop immediately. No replacement or retry.
ownership: Single controller monitors whole descendant RSS; sandbox native child only writes fresh rawstage and connects exact owned loopback relay. Main thread performs ledger/resource checks; DNS subprocess ownership registration is thread-safe without SQLite work. Native/resolver killed and reaped on ordinary failures. DNS <=5sec; native active55/external60; global active21595/external21600. Entire attempt setup/precharge/pacing/transport/validation/ledger/receipt is protected by main-thread active55-second SIGALRM independently of cooperative transport. Active expiry is fatal, never a continue timeout. During cleanup hard60-second alarm exits124 preserving pending charges/active PID ownership evidence for parent reconciliation. Both timers clamp original global active/hard deadlines; global timer restored only after attempt context unwinds.
crash_limit: SIGKILL of controller cannot run finally: parent must use active ownership PID+ps identity and reap owned groups before any reconciliation or further writer. No universal automatic crash-recovery guarantee.

output_inventory.success: SHA256 and size inventory of surviving regular artifacts; terminal result/inventory/controller preallocated slots declared separately.
output_inventory.partial: All failed partials preserved; bounded stat inventory explicitly makes no all-artifact SHA claim.
output_inventory.semantics: COMPLETE means finite profile terminal, not 300 successful books. Per-record states/complete/independent failure/unattempted counts remain explicit.

source_quality: Catalog extents and death/component metadata are discovery priorities only. Current body original-English, edition/components, rights, language, semantic quality, family/leakage and token counts remain pending.
